displayName: stocks: held tickers Yahoo does not list

documentation.content: The price pass heard Yahoo say it has no symbol for a ticker somebody holds (`yahoo.unlisted`) — almost always a bare broker code (SAN for SAN.MC). The position holds at cost with no price until it is mapped. Fires again after a restart for the same codes, so at most once a day. Triage: `uv run stocks logs tail --since 24h --event yahoo.unlisted --json` lists the codes; map each under `aliases:` in the root watchlist.yaml.
